title: 10x is passing everything it reads to the Standard path
description: Alerts when, over the last hour, the bytes the 10x Engine forwarded on the pass route equal the bytes it read, which means no limit moved any excess to Flex, to storage, or to drop. Forwarded counts every route, so only the pass route shows what stayed on the Standard path. Requires the rate receiver, which tags each series with its route.

definition.name: [log10x] Everything passes to the Standard path
definition.message:
In `{{tenx_env.name}}`, every byte the 10x Engine read over the last hour went to the Standard path (`routestate:pass`).

To resolve:
1. Check the limits and actions the engine loaded: the caps and actions files, or the fleet default (`rateReceiverDefaultAction`) for services with no row
2. Confirm the policy the engine loaded is the one intended for this environment
